With false: first gap12,second8,last2,result holder24=>94game. Result item16game centers in the holder. Native source content has3game panel inset, but symmetric centering preserves these item positions.
tradeOffer.arrows: Offer arrow-holder16x16game. Normal16x13rightimage centers vertically; cross15x15right_middle; locked8x8center. Lock sourceRGB is multiplied by[0,0,0], represented by brightness0 preserving original alpha.
tradeOffer.priceChanges: TradeCost.item.count is the current visible price; originalCount explicitly supplies the crossed old price. Both counts must be finite nonnegative integers after normalization; noNaN/Infinitytext is emitted. Changed price group has source2game gap,bottom_middle offset[4,1]. Red_slash is the real5x2sprite with LTRB[2,0,2,0], displayed6x2(single)or12x2(double) at bottom_right offset[0,-4]. Count formatting and glyph baseline use the existing font profile.

independentQa.execution: All 27 independent trading/mount tests have PASS evidence across batches; this is not a claim that one complete 27-test run was green. Original 23: 21 passed, two locked surfaces failed; nine targeted follow-up checks passed seven and exposed a QA stale-box issue plus the production XP wrapper-selector defect; final two detail/XP checks passed after the respective narrow fixes. Subsequent accessible-name correction was followed by one complete 27/27 passing regression run (1.7m), retaining all source PNG/RGBA oracles.
independentQa.coverage: Source PNG pins, 28/24-game main-slot geometry, 36 inventory cells, controlled trade/result/offer availability, 1/3/5-column mount storage, four occupied/empty equipment overlays, source asymmetric arrows, offer state skins, invalid red slots, three detail callbacks and real-rune absence semantics, purple details and complete four-layer XP composition.
independentQa.nativeWholeScreen: No same-state native trading/mount capture; no whole-screen pixel-perfect claim.

accessibleNames.finding: Live main-page axe reproduced three label-content-name-mismatch failures: two discounted Paper offers exposed concatenated visible text 2412, and the locked offer exposed 612 while its label omitted the quantities.
accessibleNames.fix: Real whitespace now separates old/current and cost/result count text without changing fixed flex dimensions. The default accessible name retains offer.label and, when needed, appends visible quantities in display order with InventoryItem.name, for example 24 → 12 (Paper) or 6 → 12 (Diamond → Emerald). Explicit host aria-label remains an override. No PNG, CSS or text colors changed.
accessibleNames.axe: Live whole-page label-content-name-mismatch checks returned zero failures. Focused Trading all-rules axe returned no serious/critical failures; the existing duplicate landmark label remains moderate.
accessibleNames.pixels: A paired full-section screenshot compared the updated DOM with a browser-only reconstruction of the original whitespace/name DOM; 0 differing RGBA pixels. This is a controlled DOM A/B comparison, not a native-game screenshot comparison.
accessibleNames.artifacts: .cache/trading-accessible-names/result.json, after.png and original-dom.png (ignored local QA artifacts).
accessibleNames.regression: Complete independent-authored Trading/Mount suite passed 27/27 in one run (1.7m) after the final accessible-name fix; core+demo TypeScript also passed.

evidenceLimits: Pinned source bytes and algebraic geometry establish provenance, not complete native game-screenRGBA equality.
Native text/rune baselines, natural label heights, fractional sampling, full scrolling/focus algorithms and transient details factories still need same-state game captures.
Native trade and horse bindings are host state. This library does not infer trades, reputation, stock, item transfer, mount capabilities, llama strength or live entity rendering.
Pocket/Ore variants and external trading toolbar/help chrome are outside these fixed Classic main-panel profiles.
No new native trading or mount screenshot was used to claim whole-frame pixel-perfect acceptance during this implementation round.
